paragraphs.text: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets DeepSeek see screenshots and local images via MindSee. DeepSeek
Harness 插件：通过 MindSee 把截图和本地图片转成文字，让 DeepSeek 能看图作答。
DeepSeek cannot see pictures. MindSee gives it a way to look.
Paste a screenshot into the composer, or point at a JPEG, PNG, or WebP on your machine. The image is
described through MindSee; DeepSeek answers from that description. You stay on the same model—there
is no need to switch to a vision model.
You will need DeepSeek Harness and the web profile.

1. Create an access token at mindsee.app.
2. In DeepSeek Harness, open **Settings → Plugins → MindSe

e**.
3. Paste the token and save.
Paste an image into the composer and write your question in the same message. JPEG, PNG, and WebP ar
A local file path works just as well, if you would rather type than paste.
